answer.new_information: NN, Inc. (not a covered NVDA name) announced in late June 2026 that 47 machine centers would be added at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling tied to NVIDIA AI racks, with 100% of new capacity reported as pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards and a 2026 target of US$80-90m of accretive new business. The exact announcement day is not stated (event_time 'late June 2026'). The record is a supplier-side company claim relayed by Yahoo Finance with no stored pieces to compare against. The 2028 revenue and earnings figures are a Simply Wall St style narrative projection (e5) and an unnamed-analyst rumour (e6), both about NN's own financials, not NVDA. The Russell Microcap index removal and the dividend, quantum and report-promotion lines are unrelated context. No period or definition mapping to an NVDA question is stated.
